I always bring my dog ​​here because he comes out so happy. Before, I used to take him somewhere else, and he'd always come out sad. He'd spend days under the bed, refusing to go outside. But honestly, he's been coming here for almost a year now, and he comes out happy. He's very content at home. I really like how they treat him. It seems like they're completely dedicated to their profession, and that's what's important—that they do their job with enthusiasm. I think that's why the dogs come out so happy. A friend recommended it to me because she also says her dog comes out very happy, and I really congratulate them.

I usually take my Lucky for a full grooming service, which costs $98.00, sometimes $78.00. Last week, on Saturday, I dropped him off at 1:00 pm. Lucky's hair was a bit long; he's a Maltese Bichon and weighs 11 pounds. I told them the length I wanted for the cut. I knew he had a few knots, but not all over his coat because I take good care of him. I bathe him at home and brush his hair, obviously. I'm a responsible pet owner. My unpleasant surprise came when my son picked up Lucky at 3:00 pm. These people had shaved his hair, leaving him almost skin-to-skin. What a lack of responsibility! What abuse! This breed of dog only has one coat of fur, which is why they hardly shed. Shaving a dog's hair should only be done in very extreme cases where there has been a long period of neglect without bathing or brushing. I'm very upset. I don't know who made the decision to do that to my Lucky. I paid for a haircut, bath, ear cleaning, and nail trim. Look at the sample! I asked for a haircut and chose one inch, but they shaved him completely! How awful! My Lucky still has the pink color of his skin after a week. I'm going to sue them for abuse and negligence. I called them after seeing the video my son sent me since I was at work and couldn't pick him up. I will never put Lucky in the hands of those people again. They are so abusive and unethical! 😡

I've been coming here for years. This is the first time I experienced a horrible experience. The staff was not friendly nor did they listen to what I wanted done for my fur baby. I travel all the way from Denton to get my dog groomed here. I also got charged a late fee which seemed unfair to me because I had verbally told the staff that I had another appointment for myself if he was not done by a certain time. I was overcharged for a horrible grooming and unfriendly service. I'm very disappointed in today's visit.

Update. I received a response from the Owner saying I left my Senior dog in the cage for 5 hours. I received a text at 1:13pm stating my dog was ready for pick up and I arrived at 4:36. What a great way to try to redeem yourself as outstanding groomers and discredit a owner. Thanks for showing that you are not friendly or kind. As far as the fleas it is an issue that we at home are working on, but are struggling with because its normal. Fee for Fleas I understand, the late fee and awful attitude from the Owner herself was uncalled for. Especially when dropping him off I inquired about the late fee since I had another appointment 30 mins away. I was already anxious and stressed having to leave him there longer than I expected, your kindness could have changed the entire experience. Even the response to this review sounds combative and unprofessional.
